app.title: Merge 2048
app.objective: Combine equal tiles until the target tile is reached.
app.interactionSummary: The participant can make one legal board slide at a time. Examples: '往空位多的方向走' means inspect the visible grid and choose one available game.slide direction; '继续合并最大的两块' still maps to one currently legal slide, not an invented multi-step macro.

game.slide.description: Slide in one exact available payload listed by state.actions while state.status is playing.
